copyright_policy: Numeric/text comparison only; no reference frames, audio or source pixels retained.

geometry.reference_geometry_confidence: medium: inferred from dense low-resolution frames

timing.timing_confidence: medium: reference intervals are shot-ledger observations, not frame-accurate editorial exports

motion_timing.basis: Study preserves short hook/map/panel/hold/return phases and ease-out route reveals, but compresses a 174.82s reference into 25s.

shot_density.basis: Six study beats retain the observed macro rhythm; the reference has substantially more source changes and presenter returns.

layer_composition.basis: Both use a persistent vertical rail, map/panel/card layers and source chips; study intentionally removes branded marks and footage.

typography_hierarchy.basis: Study uses a large headline, small source metadata, caption-safe lower band and persistent private label; typeface and wording are original replacements.

map_route.basis: Study includes dark map plate, marker, single/multiple route draws, legend-like labels and return state; geography is deliberately dummy.

source_panels.basis: Two neutral records reproduce stacked-panel timing and wipe mechanics without satellite/thermal pixels or presenter imagery.

transitions.basis: Directional wipe, hard-cut beat boundaries and settle timing are represented; no WSJ transition artwork is copied.

audio.basis: Intentionally unimplemented: no reference audio was retained or inspected and study MP4 is silent.

actual_footage_presenter.basis: Intentional replacement with neutral cards/icons; no copyrighted footage, presenter or logo is present.

why_not_90: The study is only a 25-second representative excerpt, while the reference is 174.82 seconds with many more shot changes.
No actual footage, presenter, satellite/thermal imagery, watermark, logo, branded palette or reference audio was retained or reproduced.
Map geometry is a dummy replacement rather than the reference geography; panel content and captions are neutral training labels.
Audio timing and sound-design correspondence are intentionally absent.
Scores describe mechanics for private learning only, not visual similarity, publication readiness or evidence validity.

style_distance.replacement_content: neutral phone-event training sample and dummy geography
